CJP Leaders Fail to Appear Before Delhi Police, Seek More Time

CJP leaders Saurav Das and Ashutosh Ranka did not appear before the Delhi Police for questioning at the Rajouri Garden office as summoned. They have reportedly sought more time. Both leaders also have a court appearance scheduled for October 23. In a separate development, Neha Bora stated in a courtroom that she was not with CJP, distancing herself from Das and Ranka.
